descriptions.zh:
本接口的返回值是某组织的在不同月份的碳排列表，可以反映该组织的碳排随时间的变化趋势。使用本接口需要传入以下参数：
- 企业的唯一标识符
- 碳排统计年份
- 统计模块类型信息
- 所需的趋势类型
descriptions.en:
Queries the carbon emissions of an organization for each month within a specified year. The results are returned in a list that shows the carbon emission trend over time. The following parameters are required:

- The unique identifier of the organization

- The year for the carbon emission statistics

- The type of the statistics module

- The required trend type
